why_the_new_value_fails: It is an affirmative provenance claim that NO dependency evidence exists for Syndra. The cache contains four explicit sphere-consumption sentences (W grab, E scatter, R grab-up-to-4, R sphere-count rows) and five stack-threshold enhancement rows; a ledger of six empties plus two 'unconsulted' rows records none of them.

The stated justification — 'hand seed decided the order' — is not supported by the corpus. The documented hand seeds are the ten ComboRule entries listed in data/worklists/f2-task.md deliverable 3 and preserved as OVERRIDES by f3-task.md deliverable 3: Cassiopeia, Varus, Brand, Vladimir, Aatrox, Jhin, Annie, Lux, Zed, Aphelios. Syndra is not among them, so under the spec her order must come from the algorithmic path (f3-task.md deliverable 1: 'for a champion with NO combo-table entry, derive the order on the fly from the atomized data').

Even if a seed HAD supplied the order, f3-task.md invariant 2a ('the derived order never violates a detected setup/consume edge') and 2b ('the rationale cites real atoms') are unverifiable against a ledger that records nothing. An empty ledger cannot discharge an invariant defined over detected edges.
The scenario id itself is 'syndra_DERIVED_order_60' — a seed-decided order contradicts the fixture's own name.
